claims.claim: the gap between what costs required and what the menu boards actually charged is where those two things can diverge
claims.why: The research documents no measured gap between required and actual pricing that separates margin from cost recovery; this is the narrator's framing.

judged.sentence: The pricing room was there.

judged.sentence: They were not the reason the prices stayed.

claims.why: The research says input costs explained a minority of menu-price growth, not that they played no role. Also, 'they' has no stated antecedent, so this is read as the narrator's causal interpretation.
